diagnosis: tenant_invoice_sitemap_view instantiates a dynamic sitemap for any organization specified by tenant_slug without verifying that request.user is authenticated and an administrator of that tenant. Any attacker can supply a target company's slug, scrape /sitemaps/invoices/<slug>.xml, and obtain all invoice download tokens for that tenant.
exploit_request:
GET /sitemaps/invoices/target-enterprise-corp.xml HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.accounting-cloud.io
Accept: application/xml
